entities.label: US Patent 3,322,374, 'Magnetohydrodynamic Propulsion Apparatus' (King, 1967)
entities.sub: A privately filed 1964 patent for MHD propulsion, granted 1967, with no assignee and no government interest, which is cited in the ARV literature as evidence for a mechanism it never mentions
entities.desc: THE STRAND'S CONTROL CASE, AND IT IS INFORMATIVE PRECISELY BECAUSE IT IS ORDINARY. US 3,322,374 was filed on 30 September 1964 by James F. King, Jr. of Winston-Salem, North Carolina, at a home address, and granted on 30 May 1967 with 9 claims in Class 244-62. It has NO ASSIGNEE, NO GOVERNMENT INTEREST STATEMENT AND NO SECRECY ORDER. What it claims is a linear induction motor that uses the surrounding ionised atmosphere as its armature: coils arranged serially along the craft's axis, driven by polyphase alternating current, produce a collective magnetic field whose point of maximum flux density travels repeatedly from the leading end to the trailing end of the craft, and that travelling field induces eddy currents in the ionised fluid, driving the fluid backwards and the craft forwards. That is classical electromagnetism and it is the same physics as a seagoing magnetohydrodynamic thruster. The patent is on this board because of what was claimed FOR it rather than because of what is in it: it was offered in a discussion thread as 'ample evidence' that the 'Scalar Physics' callout on Mark McCandlish's ARV drawing refers to spin-zero scalar particles. WORD COUNTS ACROSS ALL SEVEN PAGES: scalar 0, spin 0, gravity 0, anti-gravity 0, zero point 0. The single hit for 'air force' is the phrase 'the ionized air force vector' and is a false positive. This node therefore records a FAILED CITATION, which is a different object from a disputed one: the document is real, openable and mundane, and the assertion made about it is checkable and wrong.
entities.tierRationale: Node tier C is proximity, not credibility, and the patent's evidentiary quality is not in question at all: it is a primary record and everything asserted about it here is checkable in seven pages. C0 and A0 are forced by the document itself under the board's axis rule: a patent with no assignee and no government interest scores zero on custody and zero on access, and this one has neither. D0 because it played no disclosure role; it was a private filing that sat unremarked for fifty-nine years. Tier C rather than B because on the board's own test the inventor connects to nothing: no contractor, no programme, no clearance, no sponsor. IT IS IN THE STRAND AND NOT IN THE PATENTS VIEW, and the gap record gap-king-not-in-patents-view states that ruling in full.

entities.label: Alcubierre, 'The warp drive: hyper-fast travel within general relativity' (1994)
entities.sub: The five-page Classical and Quantum Gravity letter that is the origin of every warp-drive claim in the field, and which states in its own abstract that exotic matter will be needed
entities.desc: THE PAPER STATES A REQUIREMENT AND NOT A CAPABILITY, AND IT SAYS SO IN ITS OWN ABSTRACT. Miguel Alcubierre, then at the Department of Physics and Astronomy, University of Wales, College of Cardiff, showed that a spacetime metric can be written which expands space behind a spaceship and contracts it in front, allowing arbitrarily large apparent speed to outside observers while the ship stays on a timelike trajectory inside its own light cone. He then computed what would be required to source that metric and reported the answer against himself: the metric 'violates all three energy conditions (weak, dominant and strong)', the energy density seen by Eulerian observers 'is everywhere negative', and 'one needs exotic matter to travel faster than the speed of light'. THE WORD 'DEVICE' APPEARS ZERO TIMES IN THE PAPER. The word 'propulsion' appears once, in the sentence naming the idea after science fiction. There is no apparatus, no engine, no method of construction and no experiment. The node exists because the paper is cited throughout the UAP literature as though it described an engineering programme, and because DIA paid for a Defense Intelligence Reference Document built on it. Citing this paper as evidence that a craft could do this is citing a requirement as though it were a capability, which is this strand's pattern in its purest form: unlike the other instances, it is not even a misreading, because the abstract says plainly that exotic matter will be needed.
entities.tierRationale: Node tier B is proximity, not credibility. The paper's evidentiary quality is excellent and irrelevant to its tier: it is a peer-reviewed letter in a mainstream general-relativity journal and nothing about it is disputed. B rather than C because it is structurally central to the board's exotic-propulsion thread rather than adjacent to it, being reference 1 of dird-warp-drive-dark-energy-and-the and reference 43 of dird-antigravity-for-aerospace-applications, and because 'metric engineering' as a term of art in the UAP literature descends from it. B rather than A because it is a physics paper with no programme, no sponsor and no contractor: DIA later built on it, which does not make it a programme document. C0 A0 D0 on the same principle as every other document of its kind on this board.

claims.text: THE ABSTRACT, VERBATIM AND IN FULL: 'It is shown how, within the framework of general relativity and without the introduction of wormholes, it is possible to modify a spacetime in a way that allows a spaceship to travel with an arbitrarily large speed. By a purely local expansion of spacetime behind the spaceship and an opposite contraction in front of it, motion faster than the speed of light as seen by observers outside the disturbed region is possible. The resulting distortion is reminiscent of the "warp drive" of science fiction. However, just as it happens with wormholes, exotic matter will be needed in order to generate a distortion of spacetime like the one discussed here.'
claims.source: Miguel Alcubierre, 'The warp drive: hyper-fast travel within general relativity', Classical and Quantum Gravity 11-5, L73-L77 (1994), DOI 10.1088/0264-9381/11/5/001, read in full from the author's arXiv posting of 5 September 2000, https://arxiv.org/abs/gr-qc/0009013 , opened 2026-09-19

claims.text: THE REQUIREMENT, IN ALCUBIERRE'S OWN WORDS: 'The metric I have just described has one important drawback, however: it violates all three energy conditions (weak, dominant and strong). Both the weak and the dominant energy conditions require the energy density to be positive for all observers.' Having given the expression for the energy density the Eulerian observers see, he writes: 'The fact that this expression is everywhere negative implies that the weak and dominant energy conditions are violated. In a similar way one can show that the strong energy condition is also violated.'
claims.source: Miguel Alcubierre, 'The warp drive: hyper-fast travel within general relativity', Classical and Quantum Gravity 11-5, L73-L77 (1994), DOI 10.1088/0264-9381/11/5/001, read in full from the author's arXiv posting of 5 September 2000, https://arxiv.org/abs/gr-qc/0009013 , opened 2026-09-19

claims.text: His own conclusion, verbatim: 'We see then that, just as it happens with wormholes, one needs exotic matter to travel faster than the speed of light. However, even if one believes that exotic matter is forbidden classically, it is well known that quantum field theory permits the existence of regions with negative energy densities in some special circumstances (as, for example, in the Casimir effect). The need of exotic matter therefore doesn't necessarily eliminate the possibility of using a spacetime distortion like the one described above for hyper-fast interstellar travel.'

claims.text: THE ZERO-COUNT, WHICH IS WHAT THIS NODE EXISTS TO CARRY. Word counts over the complete 10-page text: 'device' 0, 'how to' 0, 'propulsion' 1. entities.desc: THE EXPERIMENT BEHIND THE FINDING, AS DISTINCT FROM THE SURVEY THAT REPORTS IT. Francis X. claims.text: THE CONCLUSION, verbatim in the passage that matters: 'A simple model was developed of ions drifting from one electrode to the other under electrostatic forces, and imparting momentum to air as they underwent multiple collisions. It also predicted how the direction of the thrust changed when the location of the ground wire changed. Furthermore, it also predicted that the direction of the thrust was independent of the polarity of the applied voltage... It is a real technology that was designed, built, floated and measured in public by a named civil foundation. In 1985 the Ship and Ocean Foundation created a committee under the chairmanship of Yohei Sasakawa and began research into superconducting MHD ship propulsion; in 1989 it began construction on the basis of that research; and in June 1992 the experimental ship Yamato-1 made her trial runs and became the world's first superconducting MHD-propelled ship. THE POINT THE NODE EXISTS TO MAKE IS NOT THAT THE SHIP WAS IMPRESSIVE. It is that the mechanism the ARV literature offers as evidence of recovered non-human technology was independently built by a maritime foundation, reported at an international conference, and was slow. If magnetohydrodynamics were the secret, it was never a secret.

gaps.text: A RULING TO BE RESTATED AND NOT REOPENED, FROM notes/PROPULSION-CLAIMS-2026-09-18.md SECTION 4. US 3,322,374 does NOT go into the board's patents view. The five patents in that view are all Pais and they are there BECAUSE THE NAVY FILED AND PROSECUTED THEM: that is the connection to the programme, and it is what makes them board material rather than interesting reading. The sponsorship test is now checkable on two printed front pages read side by side. US 10,144,532 carries '(73) Assignee: The United States of America as represented by the Secretary of the Navy', '(74) Attorney, Agent, or Firm - Mark O Glut; NAWCAD' and 'Primary Examiner - Philip J Bonzell'. US 3,322,374 carries no assignee line at all, no government interest statement and no secrecy order, and its inventor is a private individual at a home address in Winston-Salem. King has no assignee, no contractor, no programme, no clearance and no government interest, and on the board's own test he connects to nothing. ADDING HIM TO THE PATENTS VIEW BECAUSE A PATENT ABOUT MHD TURNED UP IN A THREAD ABOUT THE ARV WOULD BE SOURCING BY TOPICAL RESEMBLANCE, WHICH IS THE THING THE BOARD EXISTS NOT TO DO. He belongs to the propulsion strand and only to the strand. A later session that finds king-patent-mhd looking orphaned beside the Pais five should read this record before 'fixing' it.
gaps.wouldClose: Nothing. This is a decision and not a gap. It closes only if a document is opened showing a government interest, an assignee or a secrecy order on US 3,322,374, and the patent's own seven pages say there is none.

gaps.text: THE MOST VALUABLE UNOPENED DOCUMENT IN THIS STRAND. Robert L. Talley, 'Twenty First Century Propulsion Concept', PL-TR-91-3009, final report for the period February 1989 to July 1990 on contract FO4611-89-C-0023, Phillips Laboratory, Air Force Systems Command, Edwards AFB, California, 1991. It is the Air Force's own vacuum test of asymmetric capacitors and NASA's contractor report calls it 'the only written report we have found from the last half-century that describes a measurement of a force while in a vacuum chamber'. It matters because it answers the specific question US 3,187,206 raises in its own text about behaviour in a vacuum, and because opening it would raise the electrokinetic row from Tier 1 via NASA to Tier 1 direct. IT IS QUOTED ON THIS BOARD ONLY AS NASA/CR-2004-213312 QUOTES IT.
gaps.wouldClose: DTIC, the archive.org/details/DTIC_* mirror, or irp.fas.org. The NASA reference gives the report number and the contract number, which is enough to search on.

gaps.text: Tajmar, M., 'The Biefeld-Brown Effect: Misinterpretation of Corona Wind Phenomena', AIAA Journal of Propulsion and Power, 42 (2004), pp. 315-318. THE PAPER WAS NOT OPENED: arc.aiaa.org returned HTTP 403 on 19 September 2026. It is the peer-reviewed form of the corona-wind explanation and it is named on this board only as reference 54 of NASA/TM-2004-213082, exactly as NASA prints it. Nothing is asserted from its contents.
gaps.wouldClose: A non-403 route to the AIAA archive, a preprint, or an institutional copy.

gaps.text: ARL-TR-3005, Bahder and Fazi, 'Force on an Asymmetric Capacitor - Final Report, Aug.-Dec. 2002', NTIS order number ADA416740. apps.dtic.mil returned HTTP 403 on 19 September 2026 and what was read instead was the authors' arXiv preprint at physics/0211001. The preprint and the published report are PRESUMED to be the same work on the strength of NASA/CR-2004-213312's reference 8, which gives both numbers. THAT PRESUMPTION IS NOT VERIFIED, which is why the dissent is carried at Tier 2 rather than Tier 1.
gaps.wouldClose: A non-403 route to DTIC, or an NTIS copy.

gaps.text: The second Hathaway DIRD, 'The Role of Superconductors in Gravity Research', item 10 on the DIA list, was NOT opened. The Hutchison finding on this board rests on a word count over one of his two DIA deliverables, DIA-08-1003-017, in which Hutchison appears zero times. Running the same count over the second would complete the finding either way.
gaps.wouldClose: The blackvault AAWSAP-DIRDs directory, or the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room. Note that guessing blackvault DIRD filenames does not work: a guessed path for the Maverick Inventor DIRD returned 404 before the real one was located.

gaps.text: NO PEER-REVIEWED PUBLICATION AND NO PRIMARY RECORD OF A CONTROLLED HUTCHISON DEMONSTRATION WAS FOUND, AND THIS IS A FINDING RATHER THAN A RESEARCH TASK THAT FAILED. Every candidate source located was the claimant's own website, a slide deck uploaded by the claimant, a self-published compilation, a personal archive site, a podcast page, or the proceedings of a conference devoted to unconventional energy, and NONE OF THEM IS CITED ANYWHERE ON THIS BOARD. THE CLAIM RESTS ENTIRELY ON UNDOCUMENTED VIDEO DEMONSTRATIONS: objects said to rise, metals said to fuse and fracture, in footage whose apparatus, controls, camera orientation and instrumentation are documented nowhere that could be opened. There is no measurement to check and no protocol to fault. NO NODE IS PROPOSED FOR THE HUTCHISON EFFECT OR FOR JOHN HUTCHISON, per the brief of 18 September 2026 and the ruling of 19 September 2026: it gets a strand row and nothing more. Two checkable negatives are carried instead, on george-hathaway and dird-series: the one named professional engineer associated with the claim names Hutchison zero times in his own DIA-funded reference document, and NASA's breakthrough-propulsion survey, which names Biefeld-Brown, lifters, Podkletnov and Alcubierre, names Hutchison zero times.
gaps.wouldClose: A peer-reviewed paper, an instrumented laboratory report, or a primary record of a controlled demonstration with its apparatus and controls described. Absent one of those, nothing closes it and a later session should not treat it as unfinished work.

gaps.text: The 1983 Los Alamos and INSCOM demonstrations said to have involved Hutchison name real people and real organisations, which is exactly what makes them tempting. EVERY SOURCE FOR THEM LOCATED ON 19 SEPTEMBER 2026 TRACES BACK TO THE CLAIMANT'S OWN CHRONOLOGY. They are asserted nowhere on this board and no node, edge or claim rests on them.
gaps.wouldClose: A FOIA request to INSCOM, or a contemporaneous document from any of the organisations named. Not a better search.

gaps.text: NO PERFORMANCE FIGURE FOR YAMATO-1 IS ASSERTED ANYWHERE ON THIS BOARD: no speed, no thrust, no efficiency, no magnetic field strength, no displacement and no dimension. Figures for all of these circulate widely. What was opened is the OSTI bibliographic record and abstract, which states that the paper describes the outline of the vessel and her sea trial test results; THE PAPER ITSELF WAS NOT OPENED. A second paper on MHD ship models was opened in the hope that it would supply the figures and does not mention the vessel at all.
gaps.wouldClose: The conference paper in Proceedings of the 4th International Conference and Exhibition: World Congress on Superconductivity, volume 1, or the CiNii record for the sea-trials paper.

gaps.text: THE STRAND REFUTES ONE PROPOSED READING OF THE 'SCALAR PHYSICS' CALLOUT WITHOUT SUPPLYING ANOTHER, and that limit should be visible. Section D of Mark McCandlish's ARV drawing carries the callout; US 3,322,374 was offered as evidence that it refers to spin-zero scalar particles; the patent contains the word scalar zero times and the word spin zero times. WHAT THE CALLOUT WAS ACTUALLY MEANT TO DENOTE HAS NOT BEEN ESTABLISHED BY ANYONE, and no claim on this board asserts a reading of it.
gaps.wouldClose: A statement by McCandlish about his own annotation, or an earlier version of the drawing.

gaps.text: The Institute for Scientific Research of Fairmont, West Virginia performed the asymmetrical-capacitor work under NASA/CR-2004-213312, and NASA/TM-2004-213082 records that its vacuum tests were 'sponsored through an additional Congressional earmark to the West Virginia Institute for Scientific Research'. A Congressional-earmark recipient performing exotic-propulsion work is the shape of thing this board usually wants. NOTHING ABOUT THE ORGANISATION ITSELF WAS OPENED, only two documents it produced, so NO CONTRACTOR NODE IS PROPOSED. A contractor node built from a byline is a guess about an organisation.
gaps.wouldClose: The earmark itself in an appropriations record, USASpending, or the institute's own corporate record.

gaps.text: GB 300,311, 'A Method of and an Apparatus or Machine for Producing Force or Motion', 1928, remains unopened by this board, and the propulsion pass did not change that. It is now cited on the board from a second independent direction: NASA/CR-2004-213312's reference list gives it as Brown's reference 3 alongside the two US patents. That corroborates the number and the year from a NASA document but IS NOT THE GRANT AND DOES NOT SUBSTITUTE FOR IT. Espacenet and the UK IPO both returned 403 to earlier sessions.
gaps.wouldClose: Espacenet, the UK IPO, or a library copy of the 1928 grant.
